data.name: Punch Punch PUNCH!!!
data.detailed_description:
You’ve recently stumbled into the town of Dempseyton, a small place focused on one thing and one thing only: boxing. You get scouted by the daughter of a famous retired boxer, and she has one goal for you: to train you up to take down the current world champion, Iron Bar. Think you have what it takes to keep punching till the end?

Punch Punch Punch pulls a unique twist from traditional 2D fighters: a stamina system! Not only is stamina used to perform attacks and dashes, but it also works as a shield for your health. When taking blows, your stamina will tank most of the damage for you. It’s not all sunshine and rainbows though, since if you’re out of stamina or pushed back against the ropes, any hits you take will go directly to your health.

You’re equipped with two basic punches.

The Jab: A weak but quick punch that has good reach.

The Uppercut: A strong punch that requires close proximity.

These punches can always be used but using them with low stamina results in much weaker power.

The player can also equip a special punch to shake up how they play. Specials can have different effects and uses, but can only be used if you have enough stamina. Fight your way through the tournaments to unlock all the specials!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GT 710 / AMD Radeon HD 5450
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card or onboard audio
